profile_text.body:
Synopsys Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, trading under the ticker SNPS. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0000883241. The company's website describes its business as EDA tools, semiconductor IP, and systems verification, and states that it delivers silicon-to-systems solutions to help innovators accelerate development, reduce risk, and drive breakthroughs.

The site highlights an announcement about advancing power and performance for AI and multi-die designs on Samsung Foundry processes at SAFE Forum 2026. It also includes a notice that visitors may interact with an AI-powered chatbot providing general information about Synopsys products and services, which may be incorrect or incomplete, and that chats may be accessed by Synopsys and its service providers.

The company has 281 legal exposure entries in California, with no individual cases specified. No products or MCP servers are listed in the available data.
